headline: Ratajski beats Wattimena to win European Darts Open
standfirst: Krzysztof Ratajski won European Tour 10, beating Jermaine Wattimena 8-6 in the final after a 100.40 average in the semi-finals.
body: Krzysztof Ratajski won the European Darts Open in Leverkusen, beating Jermaine Wattimena 8-6 in the final at the Ostermann-Arena. Ratajski averaged 92.43 to Wattimena's 86.73.

The Pole beat some big names on the way. He knocked out Gian van Veen 6-3 in the last 16 and Nathan Aspinall 6-4 in the quarter-finals. His best performance came in the semi-finals, where he averaged 100.40 to beat Sebastian Bialecki 7-5 and finished the match with a 170 checkout, the highest of the event.
Wattimena edged Luke Woodhouse 6-5 in the quarter-finals and then beat Damon Heta 7-3 to reach the final. Heta had beaten Dirk van Duijvenbode 6-2 in the previous round.

Aspinall posted the best average of the weekend, 107.23, against Mickey Mansell in the last 32. Niko Springer averaged over 105 in his first-round win over Darius Labanauskas and 102.84 against Van Veen.
Heta hit 14 maximums, the most at the event, with Aspinall on 11. There were exactly 180 maximums across the tournament.
